rows.label: RICOCHET

rows.label: CONFLAGRATION

rows.label: SETBACK

rows.label: BEGINNING

rows.label: SURGE

rows.label: STRUM

rows.label: CARDIAC CYCLE

rows.label: MALFUNCTION

rows.label: RETROGRESSION

rows.label: BRUSH FIRE

rows.label: NONEVENT

rows.label: SHAKEDOWN

rows.label: SEA CHANGE

rows.label: COROLLARY

rows.label: NOISE

rows.label: SMALL SLAM

rows.label: DISTURBANCE

rows.label: WRING

rows.label: ONSLAUGHT

rows.label: LIGHT TOUCH
rows.clue: Momentary contact

rows.label: BOXING MATCH
rows.clue: A match between boxers

rows.label: SYSTOLE

rows.label: LEE TIDE

rows.label: LIVE BIRTH
rows.clue: The birth of a living fetus (regardless of the length of gestation)

rows.label: FITTING
rows.clue: Making or becoming suitable

rows.label: TIDAL FLOW
rows.clue: The water current caused by the tides

rows.label: PRELIMINARY
rows.clue: A minor match preceding the main event

rows.label: LANDSLIDE
rows.clue: An overwhelming electoral victory

rows.label: NEWS EVENT
rows.clue: A newsworthy event

rows.label: DENOUEMENT
rows.clue: The outcome of a complex sequence of events

rows.label: LOOSENING
rows.clue: An occurrence of control or strength weakening

rows.label: BOAT RACE
rows.clue: A race between people rowing or driving boats

rows.label: THUNDERCLAP
rows.clue: A single sharp crash of thunder

rows.label: SOLAR ECLIPSE
rows.clue: The moon interrupts light from the sun

rows.label: GYMKHANA
rows.clue: A meet at which riders and horses display a range of skills and aptitudes

rows.label: FIESTA
rows.clue: An elaborate party (often outdoors)

rows.label: WARPING
rows.clue: A moral or mental distortion

rows.label: WAGES
rows.clue: A recompense for worthy acts or retribution for wrongdoing

rows.label: BUSINESS CYCLE
rows.clue: Recurring fluctuations in economic activity consisting of recession and recovery and growth and decline

rows.label: SUPERVENTION
rows.clue: A following on in addition

rows.label: RIPPLE
rows.clue: A small wave on the surface of a liquid

rows.label: LOTTERY
rows.clue: Something that is regarded as a chance event

rows.label: SHIMMY
rows.clue: An abnormal wobble in a motor vehicle (especially in the front wheels)

rows.label: CHANGEOVER
rows.clue: An event that results in a transformation

rows.label: SURFACE NOISE
rows.clue: Noise produced by the friction of the stylus of a record player moving over the rotating record

rows.label: FREESTYLE

rows.label: PERIODIC EVENT
rows.clue: An event that recurs at intervals

rows.label: SMOLDER
rows.clue: A fire that burns with thick smoke but no flame

rows.label: FOOT RACE

rows.label: AFTERSHOCK
rows.clue: A tremor (or one of a series of tremors) occurring after the main shock of an earthquake

rows.label: MIRACLE

rows.label: EMERGENCY

rows.label: FOREST FIRE

rows.label: WHISTLE
